headline: FIVE MILES SHORT

lines.t: 5 NAUTICAL MILES NORTH-EAST OF THE AIRPORT

forbid: The map STOPS five miles out. No crash site is drawn (spec note).

headline: WHAT THE RED BAR IS FOR

lines.t: A RED AND BLACK BAR ON THE AIRSPEED SCALE
SPEED FALLS TO ITS TOP — THE STICK SHAKER FIRES
THE NUMBERS TURN FROM WHITE TO RED

forbid: This is the episode MOTIF (script header): the bar itself, drawn plainly. Never explained as a symbol on the card.

headline: WINGS LEVEL, ONE G
forbid: The Board's own finding: the shaker fired WITH enough airspeed available to correct (CO-204). The card states the condition, never a verdict on the crew.

headline: PUSH / PULL

lines.t: THE PUSHER: A TACTILE INSTRUCTION TO PUSH FORWARD
THE RESPONSE: A 41-POUND PULL

forbid: Two arrows, one right, one wrong. NO BLAME ON THE CARD (spec note) -- the captain is dead and is not this film's villain (R3).

headline: FORTY-ONE POUNDS
label: OF PULL ON THE CONTROL COLUMN

lines.t: 1991 — INSTRUMENT RATING, DISAPPROVED. PASSED 25 OCT
2002 — COMMERCIAL SINGLE-ENGINE, DISAPPROVED. PASSED 25 JUN
2004 — COMMERCIAL MULTI-ENGINE, DISAPPROVED. PASSED 29 APR
2007 — ATP, DISAPPROVED. PASSED 18 OCT

forbid: Built one at a time (spec note). EVERY line carries its PASSED date -- a card of bare failures would state a fact the record does not.

headline: ONE LINE ON A FORM

lines.t: "HAVE YOU EVER FAILED ANY PROFICIENCY CHECK, FAA CHECK RIDE, IOE OR LINE CHECK?"

forbid: Illustrate a FORM; no legible generated document text (spec note; fabricated_record). The question renders as designed typography, never as a facsimile.

headline: WHAT WAS ASKED / WHAT WAS ANSWERED

lines.t: ASKED: EVER FAILED ANY CHECK?
ANSWERED, 2005: THE INSTRUMENT RATING ONLY
NOT DISCLOSED: TWO OTHER CERTIFICATE DISAPPROVALS

forbid: CO-502 is what he DID write, quoted in the ledger. The card may not add motive or the word 'lied' -- the record does not say it.

headline: THIRTEEN POINT ONE PER CENT
label: ATP FIRST-ATTEMPT FAILURES, 2008 — FAILING IS NOT RARE
forbid: This card exists so the film CANNOT imply failing a check ride is rare (spec note).

headline: WHAT EACH SEAT EARNED

lines.t: THE FIRST OFFICER, ON THE CVR: $15,800 GROSS LAST YEAR
THE CAPTAIN, ON THE CVR: ABOUT $60,000
COLGAN AVERAGES, 2008: CAPTAIN $67,000 · FIRST OFFICER $24,000

source: FACTS_LEDGER rows CO-605, CO-606 and CO-701
forbid: The $15,800 and $60,000 are the pilots' OWN statements on the CVR -- the card keeps the attribution, it does not present them as payroll records.

headline: WHAT THE LAW THEN REQUIRED

lines.t: EVERY FIRST OFFICER: AN ATP CERTIFICATE — THE 1,500-HOUR RULE
SAFETY MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS AT COMMERCIAL CARRIERS
A PILOT RECORDS DATABASE, KEPT FOR LIFE, CHECKED AT HIRING

forbid: These are requirements of Public Law 111-216 as the ledger records them. The statute text itself is an Open item (S: not yet read) -- do not expand the wording beyond the ledger rows.

headline: COULD NOT BE CONCLUSIVELY DETERMINED
quote: The pilots' performance was likely impaired because of fatigue, but the extent of their impairment, and the degree to which it contributed, could not be conclusively determined.
forbid: The Board's sentence in its own words. THE RESTRAINT IS THE POINT (spec note) -- no card may resolve what the Board left open.
